items.title: 68359_Zutty Singleton oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...You know he was with Noble Sissle for a time. [INTERVIEWEE] That's right, Noble Sissle.

ctx.x: Yes. But you know what you were saying about Tommy Ladnier getting sort of discouraged. Well I mean there was a period in the thirties, now I can remember people used to say that Sidney Becket that's terrible that broad vibrato, That's corny. There was definitely a period of that because Helen made two records when she was working for Mills. They were the first records he was featured on for years. You know he was with Noble Sissle for a time.
He didn't need anything though. You know, I mean.....
